method: One (1+5) interpretable mutation/retention generation; parent re-evaluated on the same fresh block. No coevolution or rarity features.

mutations.name: T1
mutations.hypothesis: Broader response search, less pessimistic post-response weight.

mutations.name: T2
mutations.hypothesis: Stronger two-turn closure when visible health reserve is safe.

mutations.name: T3
mutations.hypothesis: Higher hidden-burst reserve and protection of key minions.

mutations.name: T4
mutations.hypothesis: More contingent trap value and combo ordering with wider own-turn search.

mutations.name: T5
mutations.hypothesis: Conservative closure and stronger material with the old opening policy.
